courses.title: Our Courses
courses.subtitle: Programs for every age
courses.adultsStep1Desc: We consider each student's goals: lessons are tailored to your needs, and in group classes all participants are at a similar level.
courses.adultsStep2Desc: We discuss topics that matter to you, play board games, read and share opinions. Most importantly — it's live communication, like a pleasant get-together.
courses.adultsStep3Desc: We provide plenty of words and expressions, explaining basic structures so you speak confidently and grammatically correctly.
courses.adultsStep4Title: For Advanced Learners (A2+): Maximum Live Practice
courses.adultsStep4Desc: If your level is A2–B1, we focus on live communication on topics that are truly important to you.
courses.teensStep1Title: For Those Who Want to Grow Through Language
courses.teensStep1Desc: Our teen groups are for students who love English and are ready to use it as a tool for growth, communication and self-expression.
courses.teensStep2Desc: Students create presentations of their own projects, discuss current topics and role-play real-life situations, learning to confidently use the language in real circumstances.
courses.teensStep3Title: Preparation for KET, PET, FCE International Exams
courses.teensStep3Desc: We systematically develop all language skills and prepare teenagers for more complex international exams, building academic and conversational confidence.
courses.teensStep4Desc: Board games, interactive tasks, karaoke, discussions and team activities keep students engaged and make learning alive and inspiring.
courses.kidsStep1Desc: We maintain love for English through game elements, live communication and formats that are genuinely interesting to children.
courses.kidsStep2Title: Confident Speech from the Very Start
courses.kidsStep2Desc: The main focus is speaking and listening: children learn to understand English by ear and express their thoughts freely.
courses.kidsStep3Desc: Reading and writing develop gradually, while all language skills are built comprehensively. Children also prepare for international exams and feel confident in their knowledge.
courses.kidsStep4Desc: Our programme keeps children interested in learning, helps them see their progress and enjoy the process.
courses.preschoolStep1Title: Falling in Love with English from Day One
courses.preschoolStep1Desc: Through games, movement and live communication, children start to perceive English as a natural part of their environment — without stress or pressure.
courses.preschoolStep2Title: Reflection Method — Language Becomes Everyday Speech
courses.preschoolStep2Desc: The teacher immediately provides the English version of key phrases, the child repeats in real context, and gradually expressions move into active speech.
courses.preschoolStep3Title: Focus on Speaking from an Early Age
courses.preschoolStep3Desc: We provide a rich vocabulary and teach children to use it immediately in practice — the child starts speaking, not just memorising words.
courses.preschoolStep4Desc: We simultaneously develop reading skills: children easily recognise sounds and letters thanks to an effective game-based methodology.
courses.preschoolResult: The child starts using simple English phrases and understanding basic spoken English.
courses.kidsResult: The child uses English more confidently at school and in everyday situations.
courses.teensResult: The teenager communicates freely in English and expresses their thoughts with ease.
courses.adultsResult: The adult comfortably uses English at work, while travelling and in everyday life.

rules.metaDescription: Tuition payment procedure, recalculation terms for absences and illness, make-up classes and EwE School working schedule.
rules.title: Payment, Make-up Classes and Working Schedule
rules.subtitle: Tuition payment terms, recalculation and make-up of missed classes

sections.title: 1. Payment Procedure
items: Tuition is paid as a 100% prepayment for the current month by the 5th day of the month inclusive.
Tuition is paid through the personal account in the EWE system.
Registration in the system is performed by the administrator after acceptance of the public offer agreement. Login details are sent to the parent by the administrator.
Timely payment is a condition for keeping the child's place in the group.

sections.title: 2. Absence for Personal Reasons
items: If a child is absent for personal reasons — vacation, travel, family circumstances and other reasons not related to illness — tuition is not recalculated.
The child may make up missed classes in a parallel group, subject to prior agreement with the administration and availability of places.
Make-up classes are booked through the administrator.

sections.title: 3. Long-term Illness
items: If a child is absent due to illness for more than three consecutive weeks, tuition may be recalculated upon presentation of a medical certificate confirming the period of illness.

sections.title: 4. Working Schedule
items: The learning centre operates according to the official production calendar for a six-day working week.
A six-day working week means a schedule in which Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday and Saturday are working days, and Sunday is a day off.
Official public holidays and non-working days, as well as rescheduled days off, are determined according to the approved production calendar for the relevant year.
Public holidays and non-working days provided for by the production calendar are not counted as missed classes and are not made up separately.

sections.title: 5. Individual Lessons
items: An individual lesson may be rescheduled only by prior agreement with the teacher, no later than one day before the lesson starts.
Individual lessons on holidays and days off are also arranged with the teacher in advance.

rules.questions: If you still have questions about payment or make-up classes, contact the administrator.
